purpose: Pilot gate for the M0 capture pipeline: 11 pages spanning 10 archetypes over 11 hosts, so per-host delay, robots handling, SPA-vs-SSR rendering and the failure recorder are all exercised. Selected with `--pilot`.
v2Changes: bilibili search/profile pages dropped: host robots.txt disallows `*` entirely
ant-design-pro pages dropped: SPA renders empty in headless Chrome from this environment (0 body text on 4 routes, all bundles HTTP 200)

search-jd/search-phone was added to exercise cross-host-redirect recording; it redirected to passport.jd.com in one early run and then served the search page directly, so that claim did not hold (corrected in v3: the path is now covered deterministically by tools/capture/test-guards.mjs, and JD hosts are denied anyway because their robots.txt redirects cross-origin to a non-robots resource)
v3Changes: jd-com/* and search-jd/* removed: JD's robots.txt on those hosts redirects to a non-robots resource (https://h5st.m.jd.com/file-no.2/public/error.html for list/search, http://www.jd.com/ for www), so the host is now denied and recorded as robots_cross_origin_redirect instead of following the redirect
category/list representative is now huaban-com/discovery; zcool-com-cn/discover renders only 17 nodes (SPA shell) and is skipped in sites.json
search-results representative is now mi-com/search-phone (site-internal search); its same-host redirect is recorded as informational, not as a capture failure
notes: Pilot gate for the M0 capture pipeline: 11 pages, 10 archetypes, 11 hosts. Cross-host redirect handling is covered deterministically by tools/capture/test-guards.mjs (local server) rather than by a live site.
